events.title: Supreme Court Orders Supplemental Briefing in Trump v. Illinois
events.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered supplemental letter briefs in the case of Trump, President of U.S., et al. v. Illinois, et al. The application for a stay, initially presented to Justice Barrett, has been referred to the full Court. The parties are instructed to address whether the term “regular forces” pertains to the United States military and how this interpretation impacts the operation of 10 U.S.C. §12406(3). The briefs are due by November 10, 2025, with reply briefs due by November 17, 2025. Amicus curiae briefs must also be filed by November 10, 2025.
events.why_relevant: The order is relevant because it grants or denies interim relief while litigation continues.
